thread:
Ellen: Heads-up — we’re rolling a change to egress authZ shards for us-east-1 and eu-west-1 tonight at 02:00 UTC. This will rotate which NAT pools are used by our ephemeral worker shards and will rotate the assume-role tokens for the GPU warm pools. Could impact KMS decrypt calls if a node ends up with the wrong egress path. @oncall?

Raj: noted. Are we doing a canary?

Ellen: yes — canary in us-east-1a, 10% of warm pool. If metrics look good we'll expand over 30m. Rollback plan: pin older egress route via route-table override and force warm-pool reattach.

Maria: pls add a quick smoke that hits KMS decrypt + model checkout. We saw 502 spike when egress IPs changed last time. I’ll add a tracer that verifies client cert + KMS auth.

Anish: security sign-off: we rotated role trust policy last week; this change rotates STS endpoints by shard. Confirm that STS regional fallback is enabled. If not, nodes may fail to assume role -> long provisioning timeouts.

Ellen: good call. STS fallback flag is ON in prod. Also we’ll throttle the shard rotation API to 2/min to avoid token stampedes.

Raj: quick config snippet I’ll apply to the tenant pool config (terraform):
```hcl
module "egress_shard" {
  source = "modules/egress-shard"
  region = var.region
  shard_percent = 10
  sts_fallback = true
}
```

Raj: and the health-check we’ll run after each shard flip:
```bash
for node in $(list-warm-nodes --shard s1); do 
  curl -sS http://$node:9090/health || echo "$node FAIL"; 
  aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://token.enc --region $REGION >/dev/null || echo "$node KMS FAIL";
done
```

ops-bot: deploy scheduled by @ellen: egress-shard-rotation (canary us-east-1a) — ETA 02:00 UTC. Link: https://deploys/internal/egress-shard-1708512345 :rocket:

Maria: monitoring to watch: KMS decrypt latency, model-checkout errors, provisioner retry rate, and token-assume errors in cloudtrail. I’ll create a short dashboard tile.

Anish: add audit log check for cross-account assume-role activity — ensure no unexpected principals show up. Also firewall rule change: egress gateway IPs will move — confirm IDS rules are using tags not IPs.

Ellen: Confirmed IDS uses gw-tags. Firewall team was notified and will not change deny rules.

Raj: quick mitigation note — if KMS decrypt errors spike, we’ll: 1) pause rotation, 2) reattach affected nodes to previous egress route, 3) abort shard roll and force-ts refresh. That should restore decryption within 60s for warm nodes.

Maria: can someone drop the exact runbook steps in the incident channel so oncall can follow? Keep it high-level.

Ellen: done — posted runbook link in #incidents and pinned to the deploy page.

deploy-bot: canary started: us-east-1a shard s3 -> s4, 12 nodes. Observing KMS p99 latency (baseline 180ms). Current p99 = 220ms (+22%).

Maria: 220ms is within threshold but watch for error rate. If error rate > 0.5% for 3 consecutive minutes we abort.

deploy-bot: 02:07 UTC — canary metrics: model-checkout errors = 0.08%, KMS decrypt errors = 0.02%, p99=230ms.

Ellen: proceeding to ramp to 30% over next 15m.

Anish: filing a quick compliance note — rotation recorded in audit S3 prefix /egress-rotations/2024/02/hash.json and CloudTrail shows assume-role events for new shard principal.

Raj: ramp complete to 30%. No action so far. Keeping an eye on billing delta — egress route change may flip nat gateway pricing band for some traffic.

Maria: small uptick in egress cost metric in eu-west-1 (0.7%); probable cause: route through transit gateway briefly. Noted for postmortem cost analysis.

Ellen: great. We’ll continue full rollout in morning for remaining regions with same cadence. If anything weird ping this thread and @oncall. :thumbsup:
